test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) MG - RA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/327ccc8e2d6888f9e503b26fbe03576a43ff05204faaf27b2d693d8bc3403397.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dbf595f77ae5459cafb14d56ced36a8ece0756c10596bfb48d9226dea4bdc41.png] 

Option 2) YE - DY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07386b6885187e1a9407da71b081fda0b228ea2fe6c80618e40d7691f5b7850.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6ca6c2a20b30b6a3b1ae3984f8a5c8dadb9993dca8909f87657b0afff9052d5.png] 

Option 3) IL - NF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23a6b359631a40ee394f0009a09f84ffc01726c57068d11d2362737d26fcfd9e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69926b0f830f1c31a0bd091794d0559ddb5746a3458bad8d396cc6e881e3ff7a.png] 

​Option 4) FV - KO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bda03b0159a0ad2dddaa3511ab57f1a221ad0376f701d2fc77eb0730a82a1c2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d55c88d51455707eeb86546b4866e2765e040544df9f6fa4e0681db3adfebad.png] 

Thus, out of all 'FV - KO' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
